new_jobs.title: Trade Operation Supervisor
new_jobs.jd: **Work Schedule** Standard (Mon-Fri) **Environmental Conditions** Office As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. DESCRIPTION: Manage logistics operations ensuring effective product movement and customer satisfaction across Thermo Fisher Scientific's network. Oversee daily warehouse operations, import/export activities, and 3PL relationships while maintaining compliance with quality standards and regulations. Implement continuous improvement initiatives to optimize efficiency and reduce costs. Work collaboratively with sales, procurement, and customer service teams to meet business objectives and maintain high service levels. **Key Responsibilities** * Import Trade Compliance Operations (Role Holder's Own, Personal Ownership) * Own end-to-end import compliance for Taiwan — licensing, permits, and documentation — ensuring adherence to Taiwan Customs regulations and import requirements for controlled goods (biological products, medical devices, telecommunications/wireless devices, and hazardous materials). * Own product classification under HTS, ECCN, and export control jurisdictions, coordinating with global classification teams and maintaining accuracy as new products are introduced. * Conduct denied- and restricted-party screening for customers, distributors, and vendors as ongoing transaction monitoring, not a one-time check. * Own government filings, permit renewals, and compliance recordkeeping; produce compliance metrics and reporting to track program health and surface trends. * Lead internal and external trade compliance audits, own corrective actions through to closure, and proactively identify process improvements to strengthen internal controls. * Build and maintain working relationships with Customs and relevant regulatory authorities (e.g., TFDA, BOFT, CDC, NCC, MOA, BSMI), serving as Taiwan's primary point of contact. * Own and maintain Taiwan's import compliance procedures and documentation as living SOPs — not one-time mapping deliverables. * Utilize trade compliance systems and ERP platforms (e.g., SAP/Oracle or equivalent) to execute classification, licensing, and documentation workflows. * Support third-party distributor and supplier due diligence reviews in coordination with Global Compliance and Legal. * Provide training to internal teams (Customer Service, Distribution & Logistics, Commercial) on customs regulations, export controls, and trade policy, and serve as the escalation point for trade-related issues. * Import/Export Management (Team-Delivered — Supervisory Oversight) * Oversee the overall execution quality of import/export operations (booking through clearance, documentation, delivery), ensuring the team and external service providers deliver consistently — not through personal execution. * Establish and enforce formal governance of customs brokers, freight forwarders, and logistics service providers (scorecards, SLA audits), ensuring external resources meet service and compliance standards. * Own import/export cost management outcomes — duty, landed cost, freight spend — as a direct contribution to the function's cost-reduction targets; lead the HS reclassification savings program. * Establish escalation protocols for major delays, disputes, or inspection issues that the team or brokers cannot resolve, and make the call on resolution. * Oversee peak-season capacity planning and risk management to prevent clearance disruption. * People Management & Team Development * Serve as direct people manager of the Import Export Team (including the Inbound Freight function) — full accountability for hiring, performance management, coaching, and development. * Set clear performance expectations and conduct regular review cadences with direct reports per Taiwan's competency and banding framework, actively supporting promotion pathways (e.g., B4 to B5). * Act as the escalation and continuity backstop for the Inbound Freight function, reducing single-point-of-failure risk currently concentrated in one individual. * Build team members' skill development plans and cross-training, reducing key-person risk while broadening team members' career scope; proactively identify and develop internal succession pipeline. * Establish clear role clarity and accountability within the team; foster a collaborative, self-coordinating team culture that reduces reliance on case-by-case managerial intervention during peak or exception periods; regularly assess team engagement and retention risk. * Continuous Improvement * Lead team-level process improvement initiatives, identifying redundancy, bottlenecks, or manual work in import/export operations and driving automation or standardization. * Establish a best-practice sharing mechanism within the team and feed improvements back into SOPs, ensuring knowledge is retained independent of personnel turnover. * Regularly benchmark against other markets (e.g., Japan, China, Singapore) on operational efficiency and compliance practices, identifying improvements applicable to Taiwan. **Qualifications** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in International Business, International trade, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Law, or a related field. * Confirmed, hands-on experience personally executing import trade compliance — licensing, permits, classification — not governance-only oversight, ideally in a high-volume regulated import environment. * Proven people-management experience with direct reports; prior experience leading or supervising a team responsible for import/export operations. * Experience managing import-related cost and duty spend, including broker/freight invoice validation and duty optimization or reclassification initiatives. * Strong working knowledge of Taiwan's import customs laws, FTAs, and permit/licensing requirements. * Expert knowledge of GMP, GDP, and international trade regulations * Strong understanding of import/export procedures and customs compliance requirements * Proficient in both English and Mandarin Chinese (spoken and written). **Preferred** * Working knowledge of U.S. and EU export control regulations (EAR/ITAR) — applied occasionally given Taiwan's import-dominant profile. * Experience with ERP and trade compliance systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent). * Experience leading a team through organizational transition, with a track record of supporting rather than displacing existing team members' development paths.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Operation Manager

new_jobs.jd: **Role Overview** The Marketing Operations Manager is responsible for building the operational foundation that enables Cooler Master’s global marketing organization to plan, execute, measure, and scale effectively. This role connects strategy with execution by establishing clear processes, planning frameworks, governance, systems, budget controls, and performance reporting across Global Marketing, Regional Marketing, Product Marketing, Brand, PR, Social, Digital, Creative, and Events. The ideal candidate is highly structured, analytical, and process-driven, with the ability to bring clarity and accountability to a complex global marketing organization. **Key Responsibilities** **1. Marketing Planning & Governance** * Own the global marketing planning process, including annual, quarterly, and campaign planning cycles. * Establish standardized planning templates, timelines, milestones, and approval processes. * Create clear governance between Global Marketing, Regional Marketing, Business Units, Product Teams, and Sales. * Ensure marketing activities align with company priorities and business objectives. * Establish ownership, accountability, and decision-making frameworks across marketing programs. **2. Marketing Process & Workflow** * Design and continuously improve end-to-end marketing workflows. * Standardize processes for campaigns, product launches, creative requests, PR, events, digital marketing, and regional activation. * Define roles, responsibilities, approval gates, and escalation paths. * Identify operational bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve speed and execution quality. * Build scalable processes that support both Consumer and B2B marketing organizations. **3. Budget Management** * Own marketing budget tracking and governance across global and regional teams. * Establish budget planning, allocation, approval, and reporting processes. * Track budget vs. actual spending and identify variances. * Improve visibility into marketing investment by region, business unit, campaign, and function. * Partner with Finance and marketing leadership on forecasting and budget optimization. * Ensure marketing investments are properly documented and accountable. **4. Marketing Performance & Reporting** * Build standardized marketing dashboards and reporting frameworks. * Establish consistent KPI definitions across teams and regions. * Consolidate performance across Brand, PR, Social, Digital, Product Marketing, Channel Marketing, Events, and Regional Marketing. * Develop weekly, monthly, quarterly, and executive-level reporting. * Translate marketing data into actionable insights for leadership. * Improve visibility into marketing effectiveness and ROI. **5. Marketing Technology & Systems** * Own and optimize the marketing technology ecosystem. * Evaluate and implement tools for project management, campaign management, analytics, CRM integration, digital asset management, and reporting. * Ensure marketing teams use systems consistently and effectively. * Reduce unnecessary tools, duplicate workflows, and fragmented data. * Partner with IT, Sales Operations, and other functions on system integration and data governance. **6. Global & Regional Marketing Coordination** * Establish operating rhythms between Global Marketing and regional marketing teams. * Coordinate global marketing calendars, major campaigns, product launches, events, and strategic initiatives. * Ensure regional teams receive the assets, information, timelines, and guidance required for execution. * Improve visibility of regional marketing plans and activities for global leadership. * Facilitate cross-regional sharing of best practices and learnings. **7. Product Launch Operations** * Partner with Product Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Creative, PR, Digital, and Regional Marketing to operationalize product launches. * Establish launch timelines, milestones, deliverables, owners, and readiness criteria. * Maintain visibility into launch status and identify risks before they impact execution. * Ensure marketing deliverables are completed according to agreed launch milestones. * Conduct post-launch reviews and capture learnings for future launches. **8. Marketing Project Management & PMO** * Lead project management for major global marketing initiatives, campaigns, launches, events, and strategic programs. * Establish project scope, owners, milestones, dependencies, timelines, and critical paths. * Run cross-functional project meetings and maintain action trackers. * Identify execution risks, bottlenecks, and resource conflicts and escalate them early. * Maintain executive-level visibility into project status. * Establish standardized project management methodologies and tools across Global Marketing. * Conduct post-project reviews and ensure key learnings are incorporated into future programs. **9.Agency & Vendor Operations** * Support agency and vendor management processes. * Establish consistent scopes of work, briefing processes, timelines, and performance expectations. * Maintain visibility into agency spending and deliverables. * Partner with Procurement and Finance where appropriate. * Help marketing leadership evaluate agency effectiveness and resource allocation. **Key Deliverables** * Annual Global Marketing Calendar * Marketing Planning Framework * Marketing Budget Dashboard * Global Marketing KPI Dashboard * Executive Marketing Scorecard * Campaign & Launch Governance Framework * Marketing Workflow / SOP Library * Global–Regional Operating Rhythm * Marketing Technology Roadmap * Resource & Capacity Planning * Quarterly Marketing Business Review * Post-Campaign / Post-Launch Review Framework **Key Performance Indicators** **Operational Excellence** * On-time campaign and launch delivery * Project milestone completion rate * Marketing workflow cycle time * Number of delayed / at-risk initiatives * Internal stakeholder satisfaction **Financial Management** * Budget utilization * Budget vs. actual variance * Forecast accuracy * Marketing spend visibility * Agency/vendor efficiency **Marketing Effectiveness** * Reporting completeness and accuracy * KPI adoption across regions * Campaign performance visibility * Marketing ROI / ROMI where measurable * Speed of executive reporting **Organizational Effectiveness** * Global/regional process adoption * Marketing tool adoption * Reduction in duplicated work * Cross-functional execution efficiency * Improvement in marketing planning accuracy **Experience & Qualifications** * 7+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Marketing Strategy, Business Operations, PMO, or related roles. * Experience working within a global or regional marketing organization. * Strong understanding of marketing planning, budgeting, reporting, and campaign operations. * Experience managing cross-functional projects involving Marketing, Product, Sales, Finance, and Creative teams. * Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. * Advanced proficiency in dashboards, reporting, spreadsheets, and project management systems. * Experience with marketing technology and automation platforms is preferred. * Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to operate effectively across multiple regions, cultures, and time zones.

new_jobs.title: Solutions Architect  (Copy)
new_jobs.jd: Instrumental technology is used by the world’s most admired electronics brands, such as NVIDIA, Cisco, and Meta, to accelerate new product development and improve production yields. Our technology leverages AI from data generated on the manufacturing floor to automate failure identification and resolution, improving yield, quality, and time to market. In the past few quarters, our technology has become mission-critical for the manufacture of AI servers. We’re rapidly growing our global presence to enable deeper integrations into our customers’ complex manufacturing environments. As a Solutions Architect, you will work with Instrumental’s global go-to-market team to deliver technical solutions for various applications across leading electronics brands. This is a unique role that will leverage your hardware engineering background, technical curiosity, and interpersonal skills to directly influence how our customers build their products and help Instrumental scale at critical sites in Asia, with a focus on Taiwan and Vietnam. You'll gain expertise in AI applications in manufacturing while working closely with customers and our internal teams to implement high-impact solutions. You will additionally be a key player in ensuring that our solutions not only meet immediate technical requirements but also align seamlessly with customer business goals. Our team doesn’t wait for things to happen; we make them happen. Successful team members are problem solvers and adaptable – when it’s not in the playbook, they create the next play. When there is no playbook, they start one. Most of our go-to-market team is comprised of experienced engineers who understand the time and manual effort required in manufacturing and have joined the business to increase their impact on our industry. **What You’ll Do** * Technical Validation: Work with sales to validate the technical scope of opportunities for new and existing customers, considering their business goals and current line constraints. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our partners’ production line structures, initiate corresponding standardized inspection frameworks tailored to different line configurations, enabling a unified, simplified, and easily adoptable product inspection process. * Station Requirements & Implementation: Scope Instrumental solutions, whether that’s leveraging our own station hardware, optics, and nests or collaborating closely with a third-party systems integrator to work Instrumental into complex automation equipment.The Solutions Architect must be comfortable reviewing automation architecture, assessing integration risk, and influencing mechanical and controls design prior to fabrication. * Oversee Implementation: Guide and mentor the project team through specification, design, development, and deployment to ensure customer requirements are met. This role may require up to 80% of time spent in factories in the Taoyuan/Hsinchu area and other domestic travels if needed, and as much as 20% international travel to support customers elsewhere. * Customer Communication: Throughout these projects, you’ll serve as a technical interface with customers and contract manufacturers, leveraging deep engineering expertise to explain design rationale, trade-off and constraints, while synthesizing stakeholder feedback to drive designs toward robust and manufacturable solutions. **Who You Are** * B.S. in engineering (required) * Minimum 5 years of experience as a product design, process, or manufacturing engineer * Industry-specific experience in one or more of: consumer electronics, AI infrastructure, automotive, or another highly related field (you can make your case). * Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, information systems, change management, system implementation, and best practices during development, new product introduction (NPI), and mass production * Experience working with systems integrators on automation projects * A desire to be customer-facing, with a customer-success mindset * Demonstrated ability to be successful in a startup environment or as an intrapreneur in a larger organization * Excellent written and spoken Mandarin and English communication skills We’re a growing team that consistently works collaboratively, supports each other, and is highly energized by the opportunity for large impact. We actively work to promote an inclusive environment, valuing passion and the ability to learn. You’re encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn’t precisely match the job description!
